messages:
uma: Quick heads-up — invoice-preview is showing ~20% lower token counts for tenants hitting the 'burst' routing policy this morning. noticed on the canary env first :eyes:

nate: I saw a smaller delta on prod earlier. hypothesis: route.priority/tag getting stripped during proxy->collector handoff. can someone confirm if enrichment service is the last touch?

irene: I pulled traces for tenant=acct_42, sequence looks like: edge-proxy -> enricher -> collector -> tally. edge log shows header `x-route-priority: burst`, enricher log shows `route_priority=null` after JSON patch. snippet:
```
EDGE: {"headers":{"x-route-priority":"burst"}}
ENRICH: patch applied, fields: [session_id, model_alias] -> route_priority missing
```

kevin: that looks like a recent enricher change (PR #6212) dropped passthrough for unknown headers. quick workaround: preserve raw_headers in the enrichment payload so downstream can re-derive. will open PR to add `raw_route_attrs` field.

devex: dashboard/preview assumes 'route.priority' exists and affects breakdowns. if we preserve raw headers we should also add a fallback on the preview UI to compute priority from `raw_route_attrs` so previews don't undercount. otherwise customers see different billing vs real.

uma: agree. we need two things: 1) patch enricher so collector receives priority (short term), 2) UI fallback for previews (medium). long term we should standardize an internal API for route attribution so we don't rely on ad-hoc headers.

nate: ops note — the canary that introduced PR #6212 was rolled out to 10% last week. I can revert the canary quickly if the patch isn't trivial. but if we can add preserve-raw-headers flag it's lower risk.

irene: quick check: there are ~1.1k affected events in the last 2 hours for acct_42, preview delta ~18%. attaching sample event id: evt_20250301_abc123 (in thread for SRE).

metering-bot: ALERT invoice-preview-delta: tenant=acct_42 window=2h delta=18% affected_events=1112 triggered_by=enricher-change-diff

kevin: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/enricher/pulls/6277 — adds `raw_route_attrs` and flag `preserve_route_headers=true` behind feature flag `preserve_route_attrs_v2`. test plan in PR.

devex: for rollout UX I'm proposing: dark launch preserve_route_attrs for 25% of traffic, run shadow tally to compare token counts, surface a per-tenant preview diff table in Console (new column). leaving opt-in flag for enterprise tenants that want immediate consistency.

uma: sounding good. question: do we compute priority in tally or preview service? two places will cause divergence.

nate: tally should be source-of-truth for invoices. preview can compute heuristically from raw attrs for display only. but be careful with batching: batching code normalizes attrs and could collapse multiple priorities if we derive wrong. need unit tests around high-qps batching windows.

irene: adding unit test: `TestBatchingPreservesRoutePriority` — fail repro included. also found an edge case where `route.priority=burst` + `session_id` missing causes dedupe to combine events across sessions. that increases undercount.

kevin: ok will add dedupe guard: require session_id for dedupe across burst routes, otherwise keep separate.

devex: UI folks: if we display preview-diff, it should call `GET /internal/preview/diff?tenant=...&since=...` which will return sample events and computed priority. flagging internal-api naming debate: `route-fingerprint` vs `raw_route_attrs`. I vote for `route-fingerprint` as a compact stable key we can index on.

uma: prefer explicit `raw_route_attrs` first, then compute `route_fingerprint` downstream. fingerprints hide variance and make debugging harder.

nate: ops follow-up: I'll schedule rollback window 30m after PR passes canary tests. will run shadow tally for 48h and produce a one-pager comparing invoice estimates.

metering-bot: TASK created: ticket #BI-998 rollback-window-schedule (assignee=nate)

uma: action items: kevin -> finish enricher PR + add dedupe guard (ETA today EOD). irene -> test cases + sample repro. devex -> mock preview-diff UI and wire to internal endpoint (ETA tomorrow). nate -> rollout + shadow tally + rollback window. I'll draft a short customer note template in case previews change.

kevin: started test run locally, failing case fixed. pushing patch now. :thumbsup:

irene: test run green for batch window edge cases. leaving a note in PR about the session_id dedupe change.

devex: I'll add a Console flag to opt-in tenants for immediate parity, and a telemetry card showing `preview_delta` metric per tenant. design handoff in #devex-design.

uma: thanks team. let's keep thread for verification data after the shadow run. if anyone sees spike in `invoice-preview-delta` for other tenants, add them here.

nate: will post shadow tally results in ~48h. :calendar:
